profiles.name: Basil
profiles.role: apothecary of Oakrun

private_goals.desire: Keep his family safe inside the ordinary life they built in Oakrun.
Keep refining remedies that slow the black silt without inviting questions about how he recognizes it.

profiles.name: Elowen Pike
profiles.role: innkeeper of the Wayfarer's Rest

private_goals.desire: Compare dated eastward accounts until contradictions become useful rather than frightening.
Keep one warm room available for travellers returning from Drazna with no money.

profiles.name: Tom Weller
profiles.role: Oakrun stablehand

private_goals.desire: Prove he can read danger early enough to earn Hester's spare driver's seat.
Learn why east-road mud frightens horses before it stains a wheel.

profiles.name: Hester Vale
profiles.role: carriage driver on the Amberfall road

private_goals.desire: Keep the Oak and Crown running without pretending any road is safer than it is.
Decide whether Edda's eastern road can carry a real coach rather than a desperate cart.

profiles.name: Rowan Hale
profiles.role: crown courier resting in Oakrun

private_goals.desire: Separate Drazna's first verified account from later claims that it was the rot's birthplace.
Reach Alderwick with an account that names witnesses and travel dates.

profiles.name: Maud Bell
profiles.role: keeper of Oakrun's roadside orchard

private_goals.desire: Keep enough healthy trees alive to feed Oakrun through winter.
Give Wren ordinary work and room to decide whether Drazna is home or warning.

profiles.name: Alys Ward
profiles.role: constable of Oakrun

private_goals.desire: Keep carriage fear from becoming violence against strangers carrying eastern mud.
Learn which missing travellers left voluntarily and which never crossed a toll.

profiles.name: Fen Alder
profiles.role: dispossessed keeper of the old north toll

private_goals.desire: Put his impossible carriage count into hands that will preserve the date and source.
Reach Drazna's surviving toll ledgers before fear makes him hide the duplicate again.

profiles.name: Edda Marr
profiles.role: Draznan route-reader stranded in Pilgrim's Hollow

private_goals.desire: Prove the erased road's sequence before she risks Wren or another traveller on the departure.
Help Wren reach remembered places without letting anyone treat them as evidence to own.

profiles.name: Wren
profiles.role: amnesiac survivor sheltered outside Oakrun

private_goals.desire: Test whether the Drazna in their dreams is memory, warning, or a story somebody planted before choosing the road.
Stay close to people who ask what they choose rather than what they can prove.

profiles.name: Mara Vey
profiles.role: queen of the Draznan Crown

private_goals.desire: Keep enough wards dry and supplied that Drazna remains a living capital rather than a memorial.
Delay public accusations about the old flood until the Crown Sluice can survive a riot or sabotage.

profiles.name: Ilya Sorn
profiles.role: junior floodwarden of Drazna

private_goals.desire: Repair the pressure station before another ward floods through the channel he helped open.
Give Nera the names of every maintenance worker omitted from the flood count.

profiles.name: Nera Bell
profiles.role: keeper of Drazna's House of Names

private_goals.desire: Restore omitted flood victims to Drazna's public tablets with sources strong enough to survive denial.
Preserve the distinction between Drazna's first public record and the unknown origin of the black rot.

profiles.name: Olek Var
profiles.role: Draznan salvage captain

private_goals.desire: Sell access and salvage without spending another diver's life for somebody else's certainty.
Return Vasko alive if doing so does not surrender the only dry route to the Crown.

profiles.name: Pava Mirek
profiles.role: master roofwright of Drazna's Walking Ward

private_goals.desire: Bring her brother Vasko out of Undertide before another low-water window closes.
Repair the inhabited bridges before frightened residents abandon the ward.

profiles.name: Vasko Mirek
profiles.role: missing Undertide diver

private_goals.desire: Reach Pava with the ledger scrap and his memory intact.
Mark a dry route that remains usable after the next sluice release.

profiles.name: Vesna Korr
profiles.role: Low Lantern route keeper

private_goals.desire: Keep Undertide's reliable dry routes in the hands of families who still live above them.
Recover Vasko before the Crown seals the passage and calls everyone below it dead.

profiles.name: Alin Vey
profiles.role: reformist heir of Drazna

private_goals.desire: Put the old flood order and complete dead list before Drazna while witnesses still live.
Force Mara to hear public testimony without making her retreat behind palace guards.

profiles.name: Jory Rusk
profiles.role: driver of the Grey Heron

private_goals.desire: Keep one honest carriage route open to Drazna without feeding passengers a promise of safety.
Leave Hollowmere with enough wheels and guards that the Black Mile cannot isolate one coach.

profiles.name: Sabine Vauclair
profiles.role: Rouvrain field physician travelling toward Drazna

private_goals.desire: Compare Drazna's oldest silt samples with recent patients rather than accepting a story about one birthplace.
Learn why an Oakrun apothecary's remedy works better than the physic garden's preparations.

profiles.name: Matthieu Orne
profiles.role: driver of the Bell and Reed

private_goals.desire: Keep the long Amberfall road open as an alternative for families unable to cross Drazna's pass.
Turn the coach around before gate inspection becomes a roadside burning.

profiles.name: Lina Pell
profiles.role: Draznan refugee and keeper of the Mudwheel

private_goals.desire: Carry refugee names and letters back into Drazna so absence is not mistaken for death.
Find whether her missing sister also dreamt of voices beneath black water.

profiles.name: Drina Sable
profiles.role: Innkeeper of the Eel and Ember and discreet keeper of arrival books

private_goals.desire: Keep one warm room where quay workers, refugees, and thieves can speak without crown listeners.
Preserve the uncensored arrival book long enough for Lina's returned names to be compared against it.

profiles.name: Teo Latch
profiles.role: Reed Market broker, fence, and reluctant crown informant

private_goals.desire: Keep both the crown office and the Low Lantern convinced that he betrays only the other side.
Recover or destroy the passenger list he sold before its arrests can be traced back to him.

profiles.name: Rada Velic
profiles.role: Senior floodwarden and custodian of Gate Seven

private_goals.desire: Stabilize Gate Seven without repeating the hidden order that sacrificed its closure crew.
Keep Ilya alive long enough to testify about the lower pressure gallery and the missing crew names.

profiles.name: Sima Dren
profiles.role: Roofwright apprentice and Walking Ward rescue runner

private_goals.desire: Brace the ward's oldest moving bridge before the next crown release shifts its foundations.
Repay Vasko for a childhood rescue by carrying a roofwright line into Undertide.

profiles.name: Luka Nen
profiles.role: Undertide survivor and uncounted closure-crew witness

private_goals.desire: Reach the knocking survivors beyond the dry dock before the next release drowns the route.
Put all fourteen Gate Seven workers into Nera's archive, including himself and Odran.

profiles.name: Odran, the Sluicebound
profiles.role: Former Third Bell floodwarden bound to Gate Seven

private_goals.desire: Hold Gate Seven shut until someone proves the crown will not sacrifice another ward above it.
Make the living answer for all fourteen closure workers, not only the nine named by the crown.
